title: Exalted Guild Rules
intro: Welcome to Exalted! We’re here to enjoy AION 2, improve together, and build a guild people want to log in for.

rules.title: Respect everyone
rules.text: No harassment, hate speech, threats, bullying, or personal attacks. Friendly banter should be fun for everyone involved.

rules.title: Keep disagreements constructive
rules.text: Discuss problems calmly. Take disputes to an officer instead of starting arguments in public channels.

rules.title: Play fairly
rules.text: No cheating, botting, scams, or deliberate abuse of exploits.

rules.title: Respect group commitments
rules.text: Arrive prepared for scheduled runs. If you’ll be late or can’t attend, let the group know. Real life comes first—communication matters.

rules.title: Follow the run leader
rules.text: During organized activities, keep voice chat clear when calls are being made. Offer feedback respectfully.

rules.title: Agree on loot rules first
rules.text: Follow the loot arrangements announced before a run. Ask if anything is unclear, and bring disputes to an officer.

rules.title: Help members learn
rules.text: Give useful advice without insulting someone’s class, gear, damage, or experience. Everyone starts somewhere.

rules.title: Use the right channels
rules.text: Keep posts relevant. No spam, unsolicited advertising, explicit content, or sharing someone’s private information.

rules.title: Set up your guild profile
rules.text: Choose your classes, party roles, and optional alerts in #role-requests. Follow START HERE to link your own character.

rules.title: Represent Exalted well
rules.text: Compete hard and treat allies, opponents, and other guilds with respect.

enforcement: Officers may issue warnings, timeouts, removal from activities, kicks, or bans depending on the situation. Serious violations may result in immediate removal. Contact an officer privately with concerns or appeals.
